content: Today was a busy day, but I feel good about how it went. I had my computer programming class in the morning, and then basketball practice in the evening. It's always a challenge to balance school and sports, but I'm managing. I'm glad I got my programming homework done early in the day, so I didn't have to worry about it during practice. After practice, I had some time to relax and play video games before heading to bed. It's important to take some time for myself and unwind. Overall, I'm feeling positive and motivated. I know I have a lot on my plate, but I'm determined to make the most of my time at Duke and achieve my goals. Goodnight.
